_meta.description: Heart event #3 for npc_paige: The Memorial

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [You find Paige at Wren's memorial stone. She's not crying. Just... still]

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I don't cry anymore. I used to. For the first two years.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Now I just... sit. And tell him about the week.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: ...Stay. Please. I don't usually ask people to stay.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Wren would like you, Jack. He'd say you have 'good hands.'

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: He judged people by their hands. Builders' hands were the best kind.
